note: Arenac County park on Saginaw Bay (Lake Huron) just south of Au Gres at 3177 S. Rumsey Rd: 900+ ft of sandy beach, a day-use area, cabins and pavilions; trailhead for the Arenac Blue Water Trail. Open from Memorial weekend 'to weather permitting'. No ORVs in the park; pets allowed in the campground only (not the beach). --Claude
